svg.title: Deep functionality and performance review baseline of jsgui3-gfx-core
svg.desc: Historical pre-remediation architecture map, evidence-backed correctness risks, local performance measurements, test coverage, and a prioritized roadmap for the repository review performed in July 2026. The linked remediation report records the fixes and current status.
svg.text: Historical pre-remediation snapshot · see docs/12-remediation-research-and-next-turn.md for the repaired state · 18 July 2026

g.text: Inheritance is the main integration surface; red borders mark confirmed contract or correctness failures.
Main facade exports PB, painter, kernels, ta_math, Rectangle
mask iteration, apply and packed-bit copy
flood fill, bit words, color operations
Float32 intercept drift · top-entry polygons skipped · repeated pass changes output · outline/fill semantics conflated
Direct-memory design is valuable; active resize has wrong samples, overflow, saturation and NYI ratio branches.
Subview offsets and bits-per-row are dropped in several bit helpers; read_px is not exported.
PPL: sort breaks above 255; fix() retains consumed prefix; iterator copies/allocation per item.
Palette ignores valid arrays. Virtual pixel iteration is mostly NYI and is not used by active resize.
missing super(), lost writes, default-color bug, empty/unexported class
Each card represents a separately reproduced failure, not a speculative concern.
Tight 1bpp get/set conflicts with byte-row line/mask paths; total capacity is padded,
then treated as logical pixels. Buffer views lose offset/length; bipp mutation is non-atomic.
Windowing and object convolution cannot execute
Undeclared pb_source throws during construction; inherited movement uses shadow arrays;
source/pos are never initialized. new_convolved depends on every broken link.
Negative/right-overflow polygon spans alias adjacent rows; wide spans throw. Polygons
entering from above disappear because the active-edge table starts only on exact y1.
8/24/32bipp queues continue after exhaustion and read zero entries as (0,0), filling
an unrelated origin component. The 1bipp path reserves 16 MiB even for one pixel.
Public methods drifted away from their implementation
crop, uncrop, count_colors, list paint/copy call undefined *_pixel_ta APIs;
legacy callback signatures silently break inversion, threshold, masks and border paint.
Active resize and convolution borders are incorrect
Representative cases return black, saturate constants to 255, overflow after x=32767,
or throw NYI. Convolution's x-loop includes the left padding and misses right interior.
Precision, ownership and idempotence are undefined
Float32 edge increments produce off-by-one spans; processors mutate canonical edges;
Polygon and virtual-pixel getters expose mutable arrays while derived caches stay stale.
throws: installed obext export is not callable
Local Node v20.19.5 medians; lower is better. Ratios are diagnostic, not release benchmarks.
loops 3× logical bytes, writes past end
vs raw backing TA; allocates per item
• RGB/RGBA getters allocate via slice() per access
• 12-layer construction installs descriptors, closures, painter and DataView
• Per-row/per-pixel temporaries and disabled fast paths amplify GC and dispatch
What currently proves behavior—and what does not.
47 cases pass · 3 fail · runner still prints “All tests passed”
24.5% among 34 loaded core scripts; 13 core scripts never load.
• clipped/offscreen lines, polygons, masks and painter
• Buffer/subarray offsets, short storage, dimension limits
Syntax validation passed for every JS file.
Sequence correctness contracts before performance tuning.
logical length, capacity, stride, MSB bit order, tail mask, finite dimensions,
typed-array view validation, immutable metadata, checked public boundaries
Restore correctness and one API vocabulary
fix flood/window/resize/clipping; settle (pos,color) vs index kernels;
immutable Float64 edge geometry + resettable render state; remove stale calls
flatten duplicate layers or compose modules; direct row/span loops, reusable workspaces,
out-parameters instead of slice(), queue sized to image, correct 4/8-byte gates
node:test runner; golden + property/differential suites; fuzz malformed inputs;
benchmark harness with correctness checks and CI regression thresholds
Finish Palette / representations / Virtual_Float_Pixel—or label and exclude them as experimental.

svg.text: Review artifact: docs/svg/11-deep-functional-performance-review.svg · Existing worktree changes were preserved.
Red = confirmed correctness blocker · amber = high-risk drift/performance · green = validated strength
